notes.title: Go play FlyKnight!!!!!!
notes.content: [p]Hello perverts, it's been a very long time I think. I wanted to make an announcement about my latest game FLYKNIGHT all the way back in January but I just forgot, as usual. Anyway, it's an old school dungeon crawler reminiscent of King's Field but everyone is a bug. I was writer (and producer) so you can expect my usual bullshit and loathsome characters who desperately need a hug or a punch to the face.[/p][p]It's on SALE right now for basically nothing and you can even play it online coop with your deviant friends for extra fun. [/p][p]If you somehow need even more convincing it also has 96% positive reviews and we all know Steam reviewers never lie.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3108510/FlyKnight/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And since we're all here, just another reminder that we're still hard at work on Sorceress (where I'm also the writer, among a bunch of other stuff) and you should wishlist that NOW. We will have important news about it soonish.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168070/Sorceress/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: ANGELS BLEEDING is out now!
notes.content:
Hi fellow Stars Die enjoyers, my new game Angels Bleeding is out now on Steam! 

Angels Bleeding is a slasher game about a prophet who must kill 5 targets in order to achieve world peace. 
[previewyoutube=bQwATxQkiKI;full][/previewyoutube]
It's very different to Stars Die but it's still a weird game so you might like it, check it out!

notes.title: Stars Die 1.2.2c Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi, this will probably (and hopefully) be the last update for Stars Die. Thank you to everyone who reported these issues.

[list]
[*] Fixed Miyazawa going in the wrong direction and getting stuck during Chapter 5 (this time for real, I hope)
[*] Fixed Miyazawa teleporting back to her initial location after dropping down the Hollow Tower (a bug introduced in 1.2.1 when trying to unsuccessfully fix the former bug)
[*] Fixed Rygg's dialogue on the radio not displaying sometimes during Chapter 5
[/list]

notes.title: Stars Die Update 1.2.2
notes.content:

[list]

notes.title: Stars Die 1.2.1 Update
notes.content:
Here's the patch notes for the 1.2.1 update, mostly bug fixes and a few minor tweaks.

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Miyazawa could get stuck during chapter 5
[*] Fixed bug where under specific circumstances Ngugi's last conversation wouldn't start
[*] Fixed some missing collisions during Miyazawa chapter 5
[*] Fixed missing animation during Miyazawa chapter 5 if triggered by time
[*] Fixed bug where Eldridge chapter 5 wouldn't be available if any other character was in chapter 6
[*] Minor story adjustments to secret storyline chapter 2
[*] Various improvements to fullscreen settings
[*] It should now be harder for the player to get stuck in geometry
[*] Added option to invert Mouse Y during the main game
[*] Updated ending credits
[/list]
